season.evidence: Stored Apr-Jun. Logged ascents: by route name: X Couloir May 2, Jun 3 (incl. X-Couloir), Jan 1; all routes Jan 5, May 9, Jun 11, Mar 1, Apr 1. Web: route accounts say too early means fresh-snow avalanche, too late means wet-snow slides and rockfall from crumbling rock, with a spring cold-freeze sweet spot (late April through June). Keep Apr-Jun.

track.why: May 26 2018 summit, round trip from the Nooksack Middle Fork road side (start/end 11 m apart, 749 m elevation), climbing the southwest basin to the summit by the same line as the track logged by name as X Couloir (aid 810755, Jun 5): final 2 km coincide within ~100 m. Wilkes-Booth is on the opposite (northwest) face, so this line can only be the southwest-face route. Report text names no route (snow, glacier, ice climb, tent camp), so identity rests on line plus approach geometry; treat as likely rather than certain.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged as X Couloir, Jun 5 2017, summited, but the track begins at the 5,800 ft camp, not a trailhead, so it is partial; best fallback.
Jun 4 2017, starts on the Thunder Glacier (Heliotrope side), report names no route; line merges with the same southwest basin finish but it is not a trailhead track.
May 9 2025, X couloir described in text but no track.

facts.text: In early June the bergschrund's center bridge may have collapsed; missing it in the dark pushed one party onto an ice-glazed rock step far to the left.
In early June overnight lows in the 20s firmed the snow for a 2 a.m. start, and the upper couloir was in good order with few runnels and no icefall until later in the day.
about 10 pickets (May, if protecting every pitch)

season.evidence: Stored: only documented ascent in March when the ice was frozen. Web: first ascent of this northwest-face line recorded 13 Mar 2015 (AAJ), 2,000 ft WI4, one day from the Heliotrope trailhead. No repeats found; Peakbagger ascents on the peak are all southwest face.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Approach from the south and summit via the southwest basin; not the northwest face.
Starts at Thunder Glacier but finishes via the southwest basin, not the northwest face.

notes: Standard route has no trailhead pin (only a summit). The track start is at about 2,457 ft on the FR-38 side; Trip accounts describe parking at switchbacks at 2,650-3,420 ft and biking to the road end near 3,700 ft, so the track start does not match a named, confirmable trailhead and I did not propose a pin. FR-38 is described as closed since mid-2026 in our stored text.
